facts.text: Serve the mains when Carol and Monica crash into the Khan family home in Jersey City.
facts.why: In the transcript only Carol swaps into the Khan living room (Muneeba and Yusuf walk in on her); Monica swaps elsewhere and the two only knock on the door later.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Carol lands in the Khan family living room in Jersey City.

vibe.verdict: Looks the part, with a dark S.A.B.E.R. galley and the Khan family food and Goose jokes in the right places; the writing could use more of Kamala's fan energy.
